summary: Elevate your data skills with our Advanced Power BI Custom Visualizations Training. Master unique visual techniques to enhance your reporting capabilities.
lede: Advanced Power BI visualization training helps dashboard builders present performance, risk, and trends through clear, interactive reports. It is for analysts and other professionals creating executive dashboards, and covers matching visuals to decisions, building KPI scorecards, and adding interactive storytelling and investigation with bookmarks, tooltips, and drill-through. Participants also learn to assess and implement custom visuals while considering usability, accessibility, and report performance.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who build dashboards and need advanced visualization skills.
modules: Advanced Chart Selection and Visual Patterns
Interactive Storytelling with Bookmarks and Buttons
Custom Visuals from AppSource: Selection and Use Cases
Advanced Visual Analytics: Decomposition, Contribution, and Drivers
Visual Governance and Dashboard Review Frameworks
Capstone: Build a Custom Visualization Dashboard
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of Power BI, including basic visualization and report building skills. Familiarity with data modeling and DAX is recommended.
